modmenu.summaryTranslation.skyblockm-twe: Improves gameplay experience on SkyBlockM server
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.skyblockm:
Improves gameplay experience on SkyBlockM server with various optimizations and QoL features
Requires Cloth Config API for configuration
skyblockm-tweaks.config.base.title: SkyBlockM Tweaks
skyblockm-tweaks.config.storageTargeting: In some cases, clicks fail without this fix (e.g. while holding a wrench)
Popup tooltip shown above the hotbar when switching slots
skyblockm-tweaks.config.renderItemInside: For example, show target item of ES pattern when holding Shift (default)
Always show when ES interface is open
skyblockm-tweaks.config.textInputLagFix: Text Input Lag Fix in Custom Interfaces
skyblockm-tweaks.config.inventoryDesyncF: Desync happens after opening recipe search, causing hotbar slot reset and delayed inventory updates
skyblockm-tweaks.config.esTerminalScroll: Key to Hold with Mouse Wheel

If > 0: cooldown between scroll actions in ticks to prevent spam
If < 0: limit on actions per tick (0 acts as -1)
Cooldown between scroll actions in ticks to prevent spam
Key to Hold for Boosted Scroll
Boosted scrolling works like manually clicking in the interface while holding Shift
If "Deactivate" is selected, boosted scrolling is always active unless the key is held
skyblockm-tweaks.config.compactGenome.to: For experienced beekeepers only; most verbose details will be hidden
skyblockm-tweaks.config.hideHiddenArmorS:
Hides invisible armor stands that are visible in spectator mode
Useful for staff observing items in pipes with maximum render distance
skyblockm-tweaks.config.itemDisplayBakin: Optimizes thousands of custom blocks by baking their geometry directly into chunks and disabling entity ticks
Maximum entity size in blocks to bake into chunk geometry (larger multiblocks remain dynamic)
Time in ticks without changes before baking into geometry (20 ticks = 1 sec)
Time in seconds without new blocks in the chunk before rebuilding it (prevents boundary stutters)
Minimum interval between consecutive rebuilds of the same chunk (prevents spam from active machines)
Completely disables dynamic rendering of bakeable entities, preventing FPS drops when approaching bases
skyblockm-tweaks.config.itemDisplayHitbo: Adjusts barrier hitboxes to fit custom block shapes for easy interaction through pipes and cables
Prevents screen jitter when touching barriers (Warning: flying through barriers may desync with server!)
Maximum server position correction distance that the client will attempt to ignore
skyblockm-tweaks.config.skyblockPackOpti:
None: Disabled
From GitLab: Automatically downloads the latest official pack from GitLab
From Server: Automatically loads the pack received on server join
skyblockm-tweaks.config.serverPackUnlock: Unpins server resource packs, letting you place custom packs above them and avoids kicks for disabled policies
skyblockm-tweaks.config.missing_cloth.de:
In-game configuration GUI requires Cloth Config API to be installed.

You can also configure all settings manually in:
.minecraft/config/skyblockm-tweaks.json
skyblockm-tweaks.config.adBlocker.toolti: Hides multi-line [ Очень важное объявление ] ad announcements in chat
skyblockm-tweaks.config.terminalStackCou: Displays compact stack counts (e.g. 413K, 3.1K) on items in the terminal and removes floating junk from inventory titles
Removes overlapping count numbers and squares from the terminal title
Scale of the item count text in slots (default 0.58)
Scale of the '+' symbol for autocraftable items (default 1.0)
